examples: See at a glance which computer is busiest, how close each one is to the compute it keeps free for you, and which agents are running where.
Check the pack total: how many agents are running across all computers and how many cores and how much memory they use together.
how_to: Open Home, press edit layout, and add the pack machines card from the live category.
Each computer shows its load bar with the reserve line drawn on it; the fill turns red when the computer is past its line and new work goes elsewhere.
Make the card larger to see the table of every agent with its computer, cpu and memory.
